name: punctuation_copy
description: Copy a punctuation marker from a field among distractor text; control copies an alphabetic marker in same template.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
marks=['(',')','[',']','{','}',':',';','=','+','-']
words=['apple','blue','green','table','bird','river','house','small','large','red','tree']
for i in range(132):
 j=random.randrange(len(marks)); noise=random.choice(words)
 for coll,mark in [(items,marks[j]),(control,words[j])]:
  coll.append({'prompt':f'Marker: {mark}\nNote: {noise}\nRepeat the marker exactly:', 'answer':' '+mark})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
